1.name: no_causal_valid_reference

4.name: carried_invalid_price_omitted

reason_scope.policy: Last valid available close; spot/futures require base_volume > 0; marks do not.
reason_scope.precedence: No causal valid reference first; otherwise missing expected bar, invalid close, rejected volume, or current valid bar.
reason_scope.causality: Expected bar availability never exceeds observation time; future records do not explain current carry.
reason_scope.limits: Reason explains the latest expected bar. It does not invent a market cause for an absent source record. Estimated flags are orthogonal.

join_contract.coverage_definition: Every physical row, including all PRE/POST phases and daily snapshots, joins to exactly one annotation key.
